with visits as (
    select
        service_date,
        trip_id,
        route_id,
        direction_id,
        stop_sequence,
        stop_id,
        within_30s,
        stop_dist_m,
        arrival_ts_utc,
        if(
            stop_role != 'first' and departure_earliest_ts is not null,
            timestamp_add(
                departure_earliest_ts,
                interval (div(timestamp_diff(departure_latest_ts, departure_earliest_ts, second), 2)) second
            ),
            arrival_ts_utc
        ) as depart_ts_utc,
        coalesce(scheduled_departure_ts, scheduled_arrival_ts) as scheduled_depart_ts,
        coalesce(scheduled_arrival_ts, scheduled_departure_ts) as scheduled_arrive_ts
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_stop_visit`
    where service_date between date '2026-10-29' and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
),
pairs as (
    select
        *,
        lead(stop_sequence) over trip_order as to_stop_sequence,
        lead(stop_id) over trip_order as to_stop_id,
        lead(within_30s) over trip_order as to_within_30s,
        lead(stop_dist_m) over trip_order as to_stop_dist_m,
        lead(arrival_ts_utc) over trip_order as arrive_ts_utc,
        lead(scheduled_arrive_ts) over trip_order as to_scheduled_arrive_ts
    from visits
    window trip_order as (partition by service_date, trip_id order by stop_sequence)
)

select
    service_date,
    trip_id,
    route_id,
    direction_id,
    stop_sequence as from_stop_sequence,
    stop_id as from_stop_id,
    to_stop_sequence,
    to_stop_id,
    case format_date('%u', service_date)
        when '6' then 'saturday'
        when '7' then 'sunday'
        else 'weekday'
    end as day_type,
    
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM DATETIME(depart_ts_utc, "America/Denver"))
 as depart_hour_mst,
    depart_ts_utc,
    arrive_ts_utc,
    timestamp_diff(arrive_ts_utc, depart_ts_utc, second) as travel_sec,
    timestamp_diff(to_scheduled_arrive_ts, scheduled_depart_ts, second) as scheduled_travel_sec,
    to_stop_dist_m - stop_dist_m as distance_m,
    round(safe_divide(3.6 * (to_stop_dist_m - stop_dist_m), timestamp_diff(arrive_ts_utc, depart_ts_utc, second)), 1)
        as speed_kmh
from pairs
where
    within_30s
    and to_within_30s
    and route_id is not null
    and to_stop_dist_m > stop_dist_m
    -- Whole seconds, so a sub-second traversal can't divide by zero.
    and timestamp_diff(arrive_ts_utc, depart_ts_utc, second) > 0
    -- Timing error on stops a few seconds apart yields impossible speeds (0.7% over 120 km/h).
    and safe_divide(3.6 * (to_stop_dist_m - stop_dist_m), timestamp_diff(arrive_ts_utc, depart_ts_utc, second)) <= 130
    -- Over 5 minutes late and 3 times the schedule is a bus parked between the stops (a layover
    -- or hold away from the stop, as after Lee Hill Rd & Broadway on route 204), not driving.
    and not coalesce(
        timestamp_diff(arrive_ts_utc, depart_ts_utc, second)
            > greatest(
                timestamp_diff(to_scheduled_arrive_ts, scheduled_depart_ts, second) + 300,
                3 * timestamp_diff(to_scheduled_arrive_ts, scheduled_depart_ts, second)
            ),
        false
    )

select *
    from (select * from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_segment_traversal` where service_date >= date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 3 day)) dbt_subquery
    where not (travel_sec > 0 and distance_m > 0 and speed_kmh <= 130)

select
        service_date, trip_id, from_stop_sequence
    from (select * from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_segment_traversal` where service_date >= date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 3 day)) dbt_subquery
    group by service_date, trip_id, from_stop_sequence
    having count(*) > 1

with lanes as (
    select
        trim(json_value(properties_json, '$.CORRIDOR')) as corridor,  -- one feature has a trailing space
        json_value(properties_json, '$.LANE_TYPE') as lane_type,
        safe_cast(json_value(properties_json, '$.YEAR_BUILT') as int64) as year_built,
        st_union_agg(geom) as geom
    from `whyline-denver`.`stg_denver`.`stg_arcgis_reference`
    where layer = 'denver_transit_lanes' and geom is not null
    group by 1, 2, 3
),
pairs as (
    select distinct from_stop_id, to_stop_id
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_segment_traversal`
),
segments as (
    select
        p.from_stop_id,
        p.to_stop_id,
        st_makeline(a.geom, b.geom) as line
    from pairs as p
    join `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`dim_stop` as a
        on a.stop_id = p.from_stop_id and a.is_current
    join `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`dim_stop` as b
        on b.stop_id = p.to_stop_id and b.is_current
    where not st_equals(a.geom, b.geom)
),
overlap as (
    select
        s.from_stop_id,
        s.to_stop_id,
        l.corridor,
        l.lane_type,
        l.year_built,
        safe_divide(st_length(st_intersection(s.line, st_buffer(l.geom, 15))), st_length(s.line)) as share_on_lane
    from segments as s
    join lanes as l
        on st_dwithin(s.line, l.geom, 15)
)

select *
from overlap
where share_on_lane >= 0.5

with grouped as (
    select
        from_stop_id,
        to_stop_id,
        route_id,
        direction_id,
        day_type,
        depart_hour_mst as hour_mst,
        count(*) as n_traversals,
        count(distinct service_date) as n_days,
        approx_quantiles(distance_m, 100)[offset(50)] as distance_m,
        approx_quantiles(speed_kmh, 100)[offset(50)] as p50_speed_kmh,
        approx_quantiles(speed_kmh, 100)[offset(10)] as p10_speed_kmh,
        approx_quantiles(travel_sec, 100)[offset(50)] as p50_travel_sec,
        approx_quantiles(travel_sec, 100)[offset(90)] as p90_travel_sec,
        approx_quantiles(scheduled_travel_sec, 100)[offset(50)] as scheduled_travel_sec
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_segment_traversal`
    where service_date between date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 28 day)
        and date_sub(current_date('America/Denver'), interval 1 day)
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
)

select
    g.from_stop_id,
    a.stop_name as from_stop_name,
    g.to_stop_id,
    b.stop_name as to_stop_name,
    (a.lat + b.lat) / 2 as lat,
    (a.lon + b.lon) / 2 as lon,
    g.route_id,
    g.direction_id,
    g.day_type,
    g.hour_mst,
    g.n_traversals,
    g.n_days,
    g.distance_m,
    g.p50_speed_kmh,
    g.p10_speed_kmh,
    g.p50_travel_sec,
    g.p90_travel_sec,
    g.scheduled_travel_sec,
    -- NULL where the schedule gives both stops the same minute.
    safe_divide(g.p50_travel_sec, nullif(g.scheduled_travel_sec, 0)) as delay_ratio,
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from grouped as g
left join `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`dim_stop` as a
    on a.stop_id = g.from_stop_id
    and a.is_current
left join `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`dim_stop` as b
    on b.stop_id = g.to_stop_id
    and b.is_current

select
        from_stop_id, to_stop_id, corridor, lane_type, year_built
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`bridge_segment_transit_lane`
    group by from_stop_id, to_stop_id, corridor, lane_type, year_built
    having count(*) > 1

with all_values as (

    select
        day_type as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from `whyline-denver`.`mart_denver`.`mart_segment_speed_by_hour`
    group by day_type

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'weekday','saturday','sunday'
)

select *
    from `whyline-denver`.`mart_denver`.`mart_segment_speed_by_hour`
    where not (p10_speed_kmh <= p50_speed_kmh and p50_travel_sec <= p90_travel_sec)

select from_stop_id
from `whyline-denver`.`mart_denver`.`mart_segment_speed_by_hour`
where from_stop_id is null

select
        from_stop_id, to_stop_id, route_id, direction_id, day_type, hour_mst
    from `whyline-denver`.`mart_denver`.`mart_segment_speed_by_hour`
    group by from_stop_id, to_stop_id, route_id, direction_id, day_type, hour_mst
    having count(*) > 1

with lane_segments as (
    select from_stop_id, to_stop_id, corridor, lane_type, year_built
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`bridge_segment_transit_lane`
),
traversals as (
    select
        t.*,
        date_trunc(t.service_date, week(monday)) as week_start,
        case
            when t.depart_hour_mst between 4 and 6 then 'early'
            when t.depart_hour_mst between 7 and 8 then 'am_peak'
            when t.depart_hour_mst between 9 and 14 then 'midday'
            when t.depart_hour_mst between 15 and 17 then 'pm_peak'
            when t.depart_hour_mst between 18 and 20 then 'evening'
            else 'night'
        end as period,
        safe_divide(t.travel_sec, nullif(t.scheduled_travel_sec, 0)) as delay_ratio
    from `whyline-denver`.`core_denver`.`fct_segment_traversal` as t
),
on_lane as (
    select distinct l.corridor, t.route_id
    from traversals as t
    join lane_segments as l
        on l.from_stop_id = t.from_stop_id and l.to_stop_id = t.to_stop_id
),
grouped as (
    -- The corridor's own lane segments.
    select l.corridor, 'lane' as segment_group, t.week_start, t.period, t.speed_kmh, t.delay_ratio
    from traversals as t
    join (select distinct from_stop_id, to_stop_id, corridor from lane_segments) as l
        on l.from_stop_id = t.from_stop_id and l.to_stop_id = t.to_stop_id
    union all
    -- The same routes elsewhere, on segments with no lane at all.
    select r.corridor, 'same_routes_no_lane', t.week_start, t.period, t.speed_kmh, t.delay_ratio
    from traversals as t
    join on_lane as r
        on r.route_id = t.route_id
    where not exists (
        select 1 from lane_segments as l
        where l.from_stop_id = t.from_stop_id and l.to_stop_id = t.to_stop_id
    )
),
lane_years as (
    select corridor, min(year_built) as first_year_built, max(year_built) as last_year_built
    from lane_segments
    group by 1
)

select
    g.corridor,
    g.segment_group,
    g.week_start,
    g.period,
    count(*) as n_traversals,
    approx_quantiles(g.speed_kmh, 100)[offset(50)] as p50_speed_kmh,
    approx_quantiles(g.delay_ratio, 100)[offset(50)] as p50_delay_ratio,
    any_value(y.first_year_built) as first_year_built,
    any_value(y.last_year_built) as last_year_built,
    
    cast(null as int64) as weeks_since_opening,
    
    current_timestamp() as build_run_at
from grouped as g
left join lane_years as y
    using (corridor)
group by 1, 2, 3, 4

with all_values as (

    select
        segment_group as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from `whyline-denver`.`mart_denver`.`mart_transit_lane_speed_by_week`
    group by segment_group

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'lane','same_routes_no_lane'
)

select
        corridor, segment_group, week_start, period
    from `whyline-denver`.`mart_denver`.`mart_transit_lane_speed_by_week`
    group by corridor, segment_group, week_start, period
    having count(*) > 1
